articles.title: The Call Jupiter Fund Management Bulls Got Right
articles.summary: It started with hard numbers, not headlines, when Jupiter Fund Management reported H1 2026 revenue of £213.3 million and net income of £25.1 million, alongside a lower net margin of 11.8%. For Jupiter Fund Management shareholders, the return over the past year was 27.0%, including dividends. articles.title: Jupiter Fund Management (LSE:JUP) Stock Could Be 39% Overvalued After Return To Inflows
articles.summary: Jupiter Fund Management has delivered a powerful share price run in recent years, which puts a spotlight on whether the current valuation can be explained by the returns it earns on its capital. With the business back in the headlines, the key issue is how much of that performance reflects underlying profitability versus changing market expectations.
